title: Activity 2.1.1 - Seven Steps of Hacking
summary: Put the seven stages of an attack in order, from recon to covering tracks, against the clock.
body: Sort the seven stages of a hack into the order they happen, from first contact to the final cover-up, then check your work.
Tap a card to pick it up and tap a slot to place it, or drag and drop. Tap the i on a card to read its full description. The timer starts with your first move.
